[h1] Nano neighbors = 10/10 AMAZING [/h1] Followed this game from the demo and reviewed it there, [b] As a follow up can definitely say this lived up to the hype, [/b] - Customisation is still incredible and many more ways to express and customise everything you have and even wear. - Jobs are very simple and easy to play with a good levelling up system with a new job added :) It doesn't appear to grindy either with levelling up makes it easier! (OFC the minigames are fun) - Really nice to keep in the background whilst doing other stuff to check up on your little Nano and chat to friends [b] Overall [/b] Really recommend this game out for anyone wanting to just have a nice chill game on their screen whilst doing stuff or even as your main focus, with many ways to customise everything you have and be as a creative as you can be.

说是挂机游戏，实际上可以挂机获得的资源仅是家园内拜访的寥寥数种生产钱币的家具。 金钱主要来源为游戏内的打工玩法，每个打工栏目5分钟刷新一次，升级以后可以选择降低打工刷新的CD间隔让自己更好地当牛马 打工玩法就是玩各种小游戏，所以这游戏最主要的玩法除了装修家里以外就是每隔五分钟去玩打工小游戏当牛马 基本上可以说很难算得上是挂机游戏了 哦对了，如果你不想当年牛马只是想装修房子或者给小女孩买衣服 对不起不太行，所有家族和衣服的解锁依赖打工等级，必须你手动候着打工CD一点点当牛马吧等级升上去以后才能逐步解锁家具和衣服的购买权 有钱没打工等级也不能买 相比于DEMO版本来说，流水线厨师的做菜小游戏在BUG上和手感上均有一点加强，并且给了俩煎锅让做菜安排方便不少，但是菜刀的判定仍然逆天，切菜的时候很有可能安不上 某些菜肴的制作过程也很反人性 比如做培根吐司，必须先烤吐司才可以放煎蛋，你顺序反了先烤了煎蛋没放吐司，手里的煎蛋也没地方放只能扔了重新烤浪费时间 正式版游戏内新增了一个叫主播的打工职业，设定和玩法更是逆天中的逆天 玩法就是你进去看着自己的主播小人发呆，然后玩老虎机来刷观众值，打赏（也就是钱）和点赞 点赞数10个可以刷一次老虎机 然后抽卡随机抽BUFF。抽卡里的DEBUFF特别多 尤其是“职业经验获取降低”这个DEBUFF更是占据了大部分BUFF内容，且一次DEBUFF就是-50%或者-20%，你的经验DEBUFF-100%以上之后这一把你就无法获得任何经验。但是你不抽卡，观众和打赏又上不去 导致只能自己眼巴巴看着自家小人在那边发呆，然后挂机到直播时间结束以后结算 当然BUFF内也有强悍的 比如老虎机消耗减半 抽到这个你刷老虎机效率直接翻倍，然后老虎机内只要刷到几个观众数三连吧观众数叠上去你就无敌了 数值设定极不平滑，玩一把要么上天要么底边一条，倒是很符合主播职业的现实调性，可惜我不想在休闲挂机游戏内体验现实主播 游戏内号称有100+家具，实则家具里沙发和床类型占比很大，椅子等家具就貌似一种类型。想给小人装个和风卧室都没有榻榻米和矮凳。有窗户的房间就初始的，其余房间需要你自己安窗户，而按照我的个人审美评价，家具窗户都很丑 能获取金钱的挂机用家具有招财猫收音机饮水机还有游戏机和贩卖机，放在家里不安排好很违和 正式版继承DEMO存档，但使用继承存档游玩很可能会导致部分成就无法触发 官方群内已有无法触发成就的受害者 窜门需要联网且目前服务器很不稳定，有很大可能联网失败或者进房间以后卡出去 总结下来，游戏质量并没有那么高 评价因在多半好评至褒贬不一区间差不多。 该评价写于2025/11/27，如日后官方有所优化，可能会考虑改好评 因为游戏的打工设定和串门想法还是比较有意思的。

Breathtaking and Amazing!!!! 神中神，10/10,windows10系统玩几乎没有bug，1、4的纯挂机的任务就可以获得游戏点，然后去diy自己的家还可以和朋友联机互动聊天，一边学习一边挂机，而且音乐和美术设计也还很优秀，我难以置信这是我两顿饭能买到的这种游戏已经很久没见过了，现在打折后的价格在我国只需要19.8rmb我可以说真的太美丽了，完全对得起这些，你硬是要说不足把我只能说互动社交那块还得再完善，但毕竟核心就是单机挂机玩法并不影响个人游戏体验和游戏的品质，就看未来这游戏的售后怎么样了，比如多更新任务，能好友交互的或者更多简单上手的个人装饰的设计，与其说是游戏已经是算得上桌宠挂机里的艺术品了，我就说这么多，非常对我的胃口，这是我今年对这类挂机游戏的最高评价没有之一。
自定义内容贫瘠得可怜，离了打工模式人物发色甚至不能自定义。 蠢完了的蹩脚小游戏，无论玩多少次没有任何成长的纯浪费时间，vtb模式倒是有成长，但是不多。

在好友所游玩的游戏中了解到这个游戏的，本着好奇地心态去尝试了一阵，有点小小想法分享一下。相比之前的那些挂机游戏，多了联机要素，可以到好友的房间游玩，让我想到了小时候玩跑跑卡丁车到别人房间参观的日子，每次都会有不同的体验。也可以到社区中心和世界上的其他玩家交流分享，也是吸引人的一点。小游戏的话我喜欢，时间短，无压力，摸鱼时可以玩玩，期待可以之后种类能再丰富点~目前有点想要改善的就是好像都点bug，有时候想把游戏栏整体移动移动，拽半天过不来，有时候就恢复正常了，感觉好神奇。 希望这个游戏后续补丁更新会越来越丰富，期待工作室和工作人员做的更好~ξ( ✿＞◡❛)

There's a framework here for something pretty fun but in its current state it just doesn't have it, feeling more like something early access. The current loop of content is there's a few different active gameplay 'job' minigames to earn currency to get decor and more rooms. Meanwhile decor can gradually earn you money as well as a few items with currency payouts. There's a social hub and Twitch/Discord chat integration to it but it's rather bare-bones as well and awkward to get running well. Your character while adorably designed doesn't do a whole lot other than wander around and there's not many interactions for it with objects other than a few things like flopping on couches/beds, petting pets, and gambling on a slot machine. While there's some achievements as goals to grind towards you're going to see most the game has to offer, and most your idle entertainment will be decorating your capsules like a zen garden of sorts. Important to note but not being held against the game for the obvious reason of not being officially supported is that this should be avoided by Linux users. Aside from the normal problem with these kinds of games in Proton not being able to utilize transparency to show your desktop, there were graphical issues like unicode characters used in the UI unable to display making it not entirely unplayable but rather hard to do so, so at least for now it's definitely Windows only. I really do hope the devs continue to work on this because they seem nice from their interactions and there is something here that could easily change to being a recommend for me with some additional work to expand what's here into more of it, but for now I'd say it's an on the fence when on sale to a light don't recommend if you're not looking for explicitly what's shown in the trailer and store page description.

这应该不算纯粹的挂机游戏，更多的内容应该在装扮自己的家园以及好友联网的社交上。 前期要赚钱基本靠手动去玩那4个小游戏，除了获取收入外，还有经验值，突破等级可以选择游戏降低冷却时间或者增加单局收益~等级提升后可以解锁新的装饰物品购买，期间还能打开礼包开出各种装扮。所以要想买更多的装饰，必须要肝，改钱都不行o(╥﹏╥)o 游戏的装饰内容非常丰富，玩家可以花钱扩大自己的房间，买装饰品装扮自己的各个小房间，还可以购买宠物以及从头到脚装扮自己。 最后，将房间和自己都打扮的漂漂亮亮的，就可以邀请好友到自己的家来玩啦（秀儿，你又来啦）~

it's an okay idle game. as others have said the mini games take up a lot of time if you want to purchase furniture/decor. some are locked behind job levels. the asteroid and delivery jobs aren't really that fun so i don't really want to level them but i might eventually for the unlockables. the cooking game is fun but the streaming game i'm not really sure what i'm doing most of the time. it's just a gamble it seems and streaming appearance isn't that customizable. i maxed out the streamer job so i just let the job play out and use the slot machine once in a while. there IS idle money from furniture/pets. there's coins that pop up every so often and the slots, arcade and drink machines, even the money figurines give about 80/5m. i think they might max at 2k if you don't collect. furniture layering is whatever you clicked on last is the front most which is fine except when you're collecting money it does mess up the layering or it could move furniture around if you misclick. it's just that all of these machines can be kind of ugly if you want to make the most idle money lol there's not a whole lot of variety in funiture and the aesthetic is kind of all over the place? idk i think it'd be nice to see more stuff eventually and a feature to lock furniture in place. UI is a little wonky, if i try to scale up, it messes up the cooking game. i assume it will mess it up for the other games as well. there also doesn't seem to be any window lock function so that you don't accidentally slide the window around. as it is right now, i prolly wouldn't recommend this idle game but i'll prolly check back once in a while to see if new stuff has been added and update my review.

[h1][b]Nano-Neighbors[/b][/h1] For its price I could say that, in general it is a good game, as entertainment for some free time or as software to decorate the screen in an animated and interactive way the truth is that it is very useful, my only complaints would be: [u]1)[/u] that to level up the "professions" it consumes a somewhat unnecessary amount of time if you want to level up quickly, especially the [i]Streamini[/i] profession, which within its event system has a ridiculously high probability of producing [i]negative rates[/i] that can lead you to lose all the experience generated over approximately 10 minutes, and it does not have any mechanism that compensates it or even balances it, you are only left with exiting and waiting for the time to reload. [u]2)[/u] that it is not possible to connect the capsules and [i]build vertically[/i], that on this side of the world can be considered false advertising, there is surely some trick like it is not possible to do it if from the beginning you built horizontally, what a disappointment, but everything else [b]I think fulfills its purpose.[/b]

It's okay. Overall I'm fairly neutral, but I expected more. I thought I was going to be able to customize my nano from the beginning, but I can't even change their hair color. I rarely seem to catch people in the social hubs, and when people are present, its a bit of a bummer that everyone looks the same!! I enjoy the minigames, the concept and the soundtrack, and I like a lot of the furniture and outfits, but the lack of customization in general is a big bummer. 一款让机器人在桌面陪伴你的游戏，并且开始游戏前你可以选择小人的性别和肤色。随着游戏内赚到更多的钱，还可以给小人更换不一样的穿搭。 [h1]和机器人一起玩游戏[/h1] 游戏的风格为桌底挂机，除此之外你还可以玩上一些小游戏，比如说在太空里采矿石，根据时间和配方制作餐品，让小机器人当互联网主播，给住户送达快递等。比如说送快递只要用鼠标提前点到投放位置即可，做菜的话要根据配方，比如说在锅里煎个培根鸡蛋之类的同时也要注意不要煎糊了，当主播去玩老虎机，读信，抽牌获取不同的增益以及减益。 游戏的画风还是比较可爱的，当你在工作或者学习的时候就可以把游戏画面放到最小来陪伴你。 本作除了经典模式外，最近更新了一个放置模式，这个模式相对来说会更加的轻松一些，因为购买道具没有等级的限制，并且公寓的装饰可以增加收入，只要在游戏前的提示里选择开启放置模式即可。 [h1]装饰房间[/h1] 当你赚到钱之后，可以在商店里后买新的房间来扩充，还可以给小机器人买各种装饰品，比如说新的发型，衣服，新的头饰，你网名的不同颜色等。还可以购买一些装饰品，比如盆栽树木，各式各样的家具，像是床，书架，沙发，屏幕之类的，还有不同的窗户风景，比如蓝天白云和黑夜。为了让房间更加的可爱，还可以购买放置熊猫，小浣熊，东方的龙，机器狗等。 除了自己挂机还可以和好友一起挂机，可以在设置里设置成好友可加入或者不可加入你的房间，也可以去活动中心看一看跟其他人一起联机等。除此之外你还可以在对话框里打字与对方聊天。 [quote]漫话漫谈，期待关注:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44551694/]写生漫话家[/url] ←节约宝贵时间，阅读省流测评~ 欢迎加入漫话家的大家庭:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/14030826]写生漫话家[/url]←共同探讨游戏中的精彩片段，向玩家展现第九艺术的魅力~ 感谢你的阅读，觉得还行的话，希望点个赞~[/quote] 最后 未来世界风的挂机游戏，并且你可以装饰并排列你的房间，或者用鼠标将娜娜拖到高处。目前游戏更新的新模式更适合让玩家来进行挂机。

Long review because this is truly a cool game and I feel like pouring my time into describing it to hopefully help somebody make an informed purchase. Whatever I've said here you'll find in first 0.5 hours of the game, after that it's everything on repeat. Cute interactive desktop toy you can have chilling on top of things, sometimes fiddling with it in case you want a mental break. It has idle mode but I'm doing it the traditional way by just playing the minigames and messing around with it. Soundtrack is there to keep you company and it's a nice addition to it, it's really good too. It's simple looped tune but that tune really plays into the relaxing and comfy aesthetic the game has going for it. -- Customization & Social aspect Customization is really limited there's only really one hair color but plenty of cute clothing you can dress your nano in. Social spaces are dead nowadays so the chat room aspect is gone and social aspect along with it. The game is way past it's prime unfortunately for those who were looking forward to that. You can visit two spaces or open up your own for anyone to join. These two spaces are really nice and make it easier to get in the mood to even roleplay if you so wish but they're nothing too amazing either. It's just a train ride space and a shop street space. Since this game is more or so just a shell of it's former self, it feels like exploring a dead MMO that used to hum with life and many untold stories. It just feels incredibly lonely. -- Minigames Minigames are alright, you can spend your coins to upgrade specific gameplay elements in them. Most of them are quite short and last under a minute, the longest one being Streamini. Streamini consequently also being the most flawed minigame out of them all where it's next to impossible to level up as it's unnecessarily punishing. Like yeah so is normal streaming but getting XP debuffs left 'n' right or even having the game smite your gains in half is just cruel. Delivery is mostly getting a hang of when to yeet the package, Cooking is my most favorite one with it's very simplified but fun approach to fast cooking simple and more extensive meals. Asteroid shooting is shortest one and it's just something to kill time with. That's all minigames in the game and some of them would've benefited from having more content in them. Playing minigames and earning levels earns you both currency and pieces of furniture & clothing. In normal mode pieces of furtniture and clothing are locked under minigame levels which would be great but... those level requirements are quite high. Example: Level 15 in Asteroids, Level 7 in cooking and so on. In idle mode, that is removed but you don't earn money from doing minigames. -- Interactivity & Immersion Game tells you that you should right-click and see if something is interactable but barely anything is. Mostly beds that allow you to sleep and very small handful of items. That giant arcade cab you got? Yeah you can just lock it and that's that. The couch at least makes your nano enter coma, they won't get off by themselves so you can leave 'em be and come back and they will still be napping which is lame. Placed furniture earns you idle income. There isn't much variety in terms of furniture, this is more Sci-Fi oriented game so everything will be high-tech and somewhat gloomy at the same time with bright stuff here 'n' there. Which is a shame, I would love for this game to have as much cute things as possible to help it detach from that cold look. From time to time your nano will want to talk to you but I suppose they're not the best at social interactions since all I got back was "I have a feeling you only click me to see what I have to say" and "Click me again and I will act like I don't like it". I'm also socially awkward so I can relate to my little goober on the screen. -- Integrations There's Twitch integration which I think spawns your viewers inside the game and maybe relays their message but I think it's just the first one. You can visit your friends too but eh, like I've said this game is dead nowadays and chances of your friend owning this is fairly slim. -- Bugs After visiting any public space, the game will keep multiplying first room. It basically dupes the first starting room every time you go in and out of social spaces so you'll endlessly be granted two - three rooms that you will need to manually remove each time. The rest of the game I didn't find anything too jarring to complain about so that will be the only thing I will talk about here. -- Final thoughts Honestly I've expected more but I suspect developers have moved on from this game and it will remain in this state for eternity. I don't blame them, this is a social game and like I've said, it's dead. 2 players in-game at the time of writing this review. Still, It has that cute framework going for it, it just lacks more interaction and more interesting elements, maybe even interactions with our nano. I kinda came at it expecting like a tamagotchi-style game and all I got was more or so fancy wrapper for an chatting app with toys to kill time with. Either way, I do still recommend it because it really reminded me of times where everything used to be simpler and way more relaxed, it's a very comforting game that calmed down my frayed nerves a little.
